tables.name: Stinger
tables.notes: NOTE: A critical result means the attack has injected poison, in addition to a normal critical result (if applicable). NOTE: Swarms of very small creatures (i.e., bees) could roll on this table as a small attack. NOTE: A really huge stinger (longer than 1') should use the Horn Attack Table. CRITICAL STRIKES: P = Puncture, S = Slash, K = Krush, G = Grapple, U = Unbalance, T = Tiny

tables.name: Trample/Stomp
tables.notes: NOTE: An F-severity critical indicates an E-critical roll and a C-critical roll (both Krush criticals). NOTE: If the target is down the attacker obtains + 30 in addition to its other bonuses. CRITICAL STRIKES: P = Puncture, S = Slash, K = Krush, G = Grapple, U = Unbalance, T = Tiny

tables.name: Ram/Butt/Bash
notes: NOTE: If the attacking creature is "charging," it obtains + 20 on this table in addition to any other bonuses.

tables.name: Beak/Pincher
notes: Animals attempting to hold onto a target (on this table) may be given an additional attack on the Grapple Attack Table if they obtain a critical strike result on this table.

tables.name: Bite
notes: Animals attempting to hold onto a target (on this table) may be given an additional attack on the Grapple Attack Table if they obtain a critical result on this table.

tables.name: Grapple/Swallow
notes: NOTE: For each consecutive round that a creature obtains a critical strike on the same target (on this table), the creature obtains an additional +10 against that target.

tables.name: Horn/Tusk
notes: NOTE: If the attacking creature is "charging," it obtains a + 20 on this table in addition to its other bonuses.

tables.name: Tiny Animal
notes: NOTE: This table is used only for very small animals (e.g. house cats).
NOTE: The maximum result depends upon how many consecutive critical results were achieved in the rounds immediately proceeding the attack.

Divider labels (verbatim, in order): "Normal Maximum Results for an Attack" (after 103-105), "Maximum Results for an Attack the Round After a Critical Result" (after 118-120), "Maximum Results for an Attack the Round After Two Consecutive Critical Results" (after 133-135), "Maximum Results for an Attack the Round After Three or More Consecutive Critical Results" (after 148-150). The S/M/L/H keys record divider positions only; this table has no Small/Medium/Large/Huge size bands.

_ruling: 2026-09-28 user ruling: the book (Arms Law & Claw Law) is the sole authority. XML-derived weapon tables shed; book values used for all 32 book tables. Claw Law animal attack tables (11.1.1-11.1.9) book-transcribed 2026-10-01 with maximum-result thresholds (S105/M120/L135/H150; Tiny Animal: normal max 105, escalation per consecutive criticals in notes) and per-table F-severity rules. Remaining PROVISIONAL (source xml-provisional): Fall/Crush, Brawl, MA Strikes, MA Sweeps (11.2) and spell tables, pending book transcription / later spell work. Fumble: book UM rule; roll on the Weapon Fumble Table (fumble-table.json).
